_note: core/orbit_camera.gd (docs/design-plans/two-streets.md §1). projection: orthogonal (no perspective) or perspective (fov in degrees, used only then). distance: metres from the look-at point to the camera when orthogonal (only has to clear the tallest building). pitch: tilt limits in degrees above the ground. height: zoom limits, metres of ground the screen is tall. keySpeed: screen heights per second with the keys. dragStart: pixels the left button must move before it pans (less = a click, left for gameplay). turnPerPixel / tiltPerPixel: degrees per pixel of middle-button drag. zoomStep: zoom factor per wheel notch.
